scene: Day 214, a long grey motorway in winter. A sea of green walkers fills every lane like a dark lake, all facing the middle, where the beige coach stands stranded; on its roof, beside an open hatch, the woman (round white head, brown driving goggles, long grey scarf) sits waving one arm. In the foreground, on the empty side of the metal central barrier, Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye) leans out of the driver's window of the white truck, eyes huge, one sweat drop, his mitten hand on the horn, as the nearest walkers begin to turn their heads toward him. Tense because one blast of that horn will turn the whole horde his way.

Day 215, close up inside the cab of the white truck rolling slowly along a motorway. Patch grips the wheel with wide terrified eyes, orange bandage close to the camera, Nora (purple band on her forearm) beside him clutching the flashlight. Just outside the driver's window, the long metal central barrier is bending toward the truck under thousands of green walkers pressing against it, their hands and open mouths right at the glass, a whole motorway of them stretching back to the horizon. Tense because the barrier is the only thing between the truck and the horde.
